name: g3rest
note: The green cube already sits on top of the red cube: first gently unstack the green cube and set it down at a free spot beside the stack, then grasp the now-exposed red cube from the side (not from above, where the green cube would get in the way), lift it, and place it on top of the green cube using place_z = green_center_z + green_extent[2]/2 + red_extent[2]/2, opening the gripper after.
